title: Bobby Neal and Lynn Pack
summary: Neal was a bassist in taxi dance halls, and Pack was an altoist who left for Europe; Holmes never played with either.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about a musician who I know really nothing about. His name is Bobby Neal.

Yeah, Bobby Neal was a... I think he was a bass player. He used to have a band around here. I can't tell you too much about him, because I never worked for him, but I knew people that did work for him.
In the dancing schools downtown. You know, them taxi dance halls. He played in there, Bobby Neal.
Now, what about somebody like Lynn Pack(?)?
Yeah, sure. Alto player. He left I guess in the Thirties to go to Europe, and he never come back. The Thirties or early Forties. I think it was the Thirties.
But you were never in any bands with him.
No, I never was in any bands. But he was one of them boys from around the Rhythm Club. You could see him in the Rhythm Club every day.
